description: This file defines the ShippingQuoteModule interface, which declares methods for validating shipping module configurations, retrieving custom configurations, and obtaining shipping quotes in a shopping or shipping system.

classes.name: ShippingQuoteModule
classes.description: An interface defining methods for shipping quote modules, including validation, configuration retrieval, and obtaining shipping quotes.

methods.name: validateModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Validates the configuration of a shipping module given an integration configuration and merchant store.

methods.name: getCustomModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves custom configuration settings for a shipping module associated with a merchant store.

methods.name: getShippingQuotes
methods.description: Calculates and returns shipping options and quotes based on provided package details, order total, delivery info, and configuration.
